1. Which step of the cycle comes first in glycolysis?

A. Hexokinase

B. Pyruvate kinase

C. Enolase

D. Aldolase

Correct Answer: A

  1. Glucose is phosphorylated
  2. Isomerisation follows
  3. Second phosphorylation

2. The second question follows right after the list?

A. Option 2 one

B. Option 2 two

C. Option 2 three

D. Option 2 four

Correct Answer: C
